evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This story specifies a distinct search method (content identification/fingerprinting) not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Uses a distinct personalization source (user profile) different from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Specifies collaborative filtering / similar-user based discovery, distinct goal from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Targets content-similarity-based discovery for music/video—different method and scope than others.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Uses enriched metadata/image tags as the distinct discovery mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Focuses on user upload and tag propagation; different actor/goal than admin prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Describes a unique UI/visualization capability not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: General 'similar' information; distinguishes from perceptual similarity (ZO-009) by being broader.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Specifies 'perceptually similar' which is a meaningful difference in similarity definition from ZO-008.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Specifies recommendation delivery from similar profiles; different purpose and phrasing than search-based stories.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Uses news-event/geo relevance as recommendation source, distinct from other recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Entity recognition for persons is a distinct detection task.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Entity recognition for products differs from person or brand detection; unique requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection is a distinct recognition task and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is a distinct target (different from logos/products/persons).

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-based query-to-video recommendation is a specific interaction not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geospatial discovery and map-based notifications are distinct functionality.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a unique search modality.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin video segmentation review/edit capability is distinct from other admin tasks.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction for news segments is a separate admin task.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a distinct business rule for content curation.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Tampering/edited-audio assessment is a distinct validation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity-specific prefiltering is a distinct content-safety rule.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: General low-level asset based prefiltering is a distinct, broad admin requirement.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is a distinct legal/business-rule check not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag based prefiltering differs from low-level prefiltering (ZO-024).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Quality/interestingness scoring combining automated and community signals is unique.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is a distinct actor/goal compared to other notification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is a distinct classification requirement.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification using simple low-level features is domain-specific and distinct.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Domain-specific detection of empty images for Snapshot Serengeti is distinct from other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Image-series detection for timestamp malfunction is a specific detection task.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Snapshot Serengeti is domain- and task-specific.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., pose/age) is a different classification than species or count.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct analytic goal from preclassification or detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is a distinct computer-vision task for a different domain.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Domain-specific empty-image detection for Plankton Portal is distinct from Snapshot Serengeti equivalents.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation measurement is a separate analytic requirement for plankton images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is a distinct domain-specific task.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis for video reduction is a unique processing feature tied to a specific project.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a specific analytic use-case distinct from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite imagery is a unique capability.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by volunteer experience is a distinct quality/confidence mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: This is a specific instance of low-level-asset prefiltering already requested in ZO-024 (both are admin prefiltering using low-level asset information) and therefore is substantially contained without a meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct analytic task not covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a distinct processing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping of whale calls is a specific audio-analytics requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting distinct whales in audio is a unique analytic task different from grouping.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of interruptions is a distinct decision requirement, different from modality or education selection stories.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Adds modality selection for interruption (text/image/video), a meaningful difference from ZO-049.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of educational interventions is a distinct requirement from interruption or modality selection.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Specifies modality for education, which is a meaningful difference from simply knowing when to educate.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selection of specific educational content is a distinct decision requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is a distinct monitoring requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Decision for Zoonibot commenting is distinct from deciding explanations or content for Zoonibot.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Decision to provide explanations is a distinct behavior for Zoonibot separate from commenting or content selection.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Specifies content generation for Zoonibot replies, which differs from timing decisions.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping subjects by similarity is a generic clustering requirement; no other story duplicates this exact need.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Admin-driven project recommendation based on volunteer history is a distinct use case.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Admin article summarization for reuse is a distinct requirement.
